## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:
```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```

```{r}
# K4_SCE <- readRDS("/varidata/researchtemp/collab/AlexEiken/Le_tran/K4_SCE.rds")
stacked_sce <- readRDS("/varidata/researchtemp/collab/AlexEiken/Le_tran/stacked_sce.rds")

K4shared = stacked_sce[rowData(stacked_sce)$modality == "K4",]
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r}
fp = fletchR:::.firstPass(K4shared, binarize = T,totalFeatures = nrow(K4shared))
projMat = SingleCellExperiment::sampleFactors(fp)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
> system.time({res = apply(
+   projMat,
+   2,
+   function(x) energy::dcor(x, var)
+ )})
   user  system elapsed 
157.069  78.707 237.552 

```{r}
var_dual = as.matrix(colData(K4shared)[,c("nFrags_K4","nFrags_DEM")])
system.time({res = apply(
  projMat,
  2,
  function(x) energy::dcor(x, var)
)})


#    user  system elapsed 
# 147.568  78.350 227.675 



# user  system elapsed 
#   5.966   2.895   8.969 
# system.time({res1 = energy::dcor(projMat[,1],K4shared$nFrags_K4)})
```

```{r}
projMat2 = fletchR::ArchRRowZscores(projMat)

system.time({res_dual = apply(
  projMat2,
  2,
  function(x) energy::dcor(x, var)
)})
```

```{r}
var_k4 = as.matrix(colData(K4shared)[,c("nFrags_K4")])
abs(cor(projMat,var_k4))
abs(cor(projMat2, var_k4))
```

```{r}
var_DEM = as.matrix(colData(K4shared)[,c("nFrags_DEM")])
abs(cor(projMat,var_DEM))
z = abs(cor(projMat2, var_DEM))
```
